nodes.text: One Friday afternoon at Twin Branches High, Emily Kessler bounds happily over to the Center Table, where Maria, Nicole, and Amanda are all sitting.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: What're you so happy about, Kessler?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Oh, nothing... Just looking forward to the weekend.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Why's that? Is your dad `finally` going to let you take a five minute break from swim practice?
nodes.text_bbcode: Why's that? Is your dad [color=#3b78e2][i]finally[/i][/color] going to let you take a five minute break from swim practice?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Actually, my dad's going to be gone all day tomorrow to go to a conference on swim team recruitment...

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: So Ben and I are going to drive to San Francisco for a date!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: That sounds like fun!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Oh, it's going to be great! I've planned it all out...

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: We're going to start by visiting the Science Center... And then we'll swing by the Street Arts Festival... And we'll stop by this great bookstore I keep hearing about...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Oh... That sounds... Um... Fun?

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Yeah... Fun...

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Why'd you say it like that? Why do you guys have sad faces?

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: It's just... A science museum? An arts festival? A bookstore?

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Do you `really` think that's what Ben wants to do in the city?
nodes.text_bbcode: Do you [color=#3b78e2][i]really[/i][/color] think that's what Ben wants to do in the city?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Well... He likes science... And the festival sounded fun... And the bookstore got great reviews online...

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Why, what do you guys think Ben would want to do in the city?
The three girls glance at each other uneasily...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: ...Should we tell her?

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: I don't know, it seems mean...

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Tell me what? What seems mean?

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Well... You've heard about Ben's ex, right? Jessica? She used to go here...

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I've heard of her...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: One time, she and Ben took a trip down to San Francisco and... Well, let's just say it's kind of a legendary story...

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Legendary how?

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Well, they were supposed to be going to some party with Jessica's cousin... She's a college student, and she was going to get them into her sorority...

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: But on the way up, they drove by this awesome parade, and Jessica just had to join in!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: She climbed up on a float and was dancing and everything!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Did Ben join in?

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Well, yeah! Ben did everything with Jessica! And then, the craziest part is, these guys saw Jessica dancing, and thought she was awesome, so they all started hanging out...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: And it turned out they were the members of `Seven Minutes in Heaven!`
nodes.text_bbcode: And it turned out they were the members of [color=#3b78e2][i]Seven Minutes in Heaven![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Oh... Them... They're a... Music group... Right?

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Uh, they're `amazing?` Their single 'Love Grrls' was in the Top 40 for like, six months!
nodes.text_bbcode: Uh, they're [color=#3b78e2][i]amazing?[/i][/color] Their single 'Love Grrls' was in the Top 40 for like, six months!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: They're `soooo` cute!
nodes.text_bbcode: They're [color=#3b78e2][i]soooo[/i][/color] cute!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Totally! And then they invited Jessica and Ben to go to their concert, `and` gave them backstage passes to party with them!
nodes.text_bbcode: Totally! And then they invited Jessica and Ben to go to their concert, [color=#3b78e2][i]and[/i][/color] gave them backstage passes to party with them!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: According to Jessica, it was one of the best nights of her life!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: That sounds amazing... I'm sure Ben loved it...

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: And it's `way` more exciting than what I had planned!
nodes.text_bbcode: And it's [color=#3b78e2][i]way[/i][/color] more exciting than what I had planned!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: This Jessica... She was really spontaneous, huh?

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Are you kidding? She was totally wild!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: She was straight cray. I mean, she was `cray` cray...
nodes.text_bbcode: She was straight cray. I mean, she was [color=#3b78e2][i]cray[/i][/color] cray...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Cray cray cray cray cray...

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Amanda! Focus! We're talking about Jessica, not just making mouth sounds!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I guess I see how Ben would have liked that... He's always throwing parties and pulling pranks...

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I bet he would've really enjoyed a date like that...

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Aw, don't feel bad, Emily!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Yeah! I'm sure he'll like your lame science and books date too!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Yeah... Thanks...
Later that night, Emily hangs out with her best friend, Kimi...

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Sigh...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Wow, you are really letting this Jessica thing get to you, huh?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Well, kind of! I mean, it sounds like she was just this wild, crazy ball of excitement and spontaneity...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Oh, yeah, she totally was. I tried to get some gossip on her, and it sounds like she was basically the human version of an out-of-control party...

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Exactly! And what does that make me? The human version of a girl who swims all the time and never does anything fun?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: That's not true! You're going to San Francisco tomorrow, aren't you? That's fun!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Only because I lied to my dad! And I have to be home by seven, just so he doesn't find out! How does that make me fun?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Look, I `really` don't think you have to worry about it... I mean, it sounds like Jessica had a lot of issues, and she and Ben had a `seriously` messy breakup...
nodes.text_bbcode: Look, I [color=#3b78e2][i]really[/i][/color] don't think you have to worry about it... I mean, it sounds like Jessica had a lot of issues, and she and Ben had a [color=#3b78e2][i]seriously[/i][/color] messy breakup...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: But... If you're `really` worried about it...
nodes.text_bbcode: But... If you're [color=#3b78e2][i]really[/i][/color] worried about it...

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Yeah?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Why don't you do something spontaneous on the trip?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: You think Ben would like that?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Of course! Every guy likes a little excitement in his life!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: ...Or so the latest issue of 'Teen Girl' tells me.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Hmmm... Something spontaneous... I'm sure I could fit that into the schedule...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Uh, no, dummy, you can't `plan` something spontaneous! That totally defeats the point!
nodes.text_bbcode: Uh, no, dummy, you can't [color=#3b78e2][i]plan[/i][/color] something spontaneous! That totally defeats the point!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I can't argue with that, but... How am I supposed to know what to do?
Kimi walks over and puts her hands on Emily's shoulders...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: When the moment strikes, Emily... You'll know `exactly` what do to!
nodes.text_bbcode: When the moment strikes, Emily... You'll know [color=#3b78e2][i]exactly[/i][/color] what do to!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: ...Teen Girl Magazine?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: 'Ten Ways To Have The Perfect Date', May 2012!
The next day, Ben and Emily drive along Highway 1, up to San Francisco...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Ah... This is nice... I always did like driving along the coast...

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Yeah, it's pretty...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I can't get wait to get into the city though... I `love` going to the science center...
nodes.text_bbcode: I can't get wait to get into the city though... I [color=#e23b3b][i]love[/i][/color] going to the science center...

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Oh... You've been there before...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Well, yeah. My dad used to take me there all the time when I was a kid. It was, like, my favorite place...

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Oh. Right. Of course.
The two drive in silence for a moment as they enter San Francisco...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uh... Emily... Is something wrong?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: No... Of course not. Why?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Well... You just seem like you have something on your mind.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: It's just... You don't really talk much about your ex-girlfriend, Jessica, do you?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Oh man. Did you hear people talking about her?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Maybe.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Look, I... I don't know what you heard but... Things with Jessica were complicated, okay?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: What was she like?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: ...Wild. Crazy. She loved having a good time, and she did everything she could to make sure the good times never stopped.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Right.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I know you probably heard some pretty bad things about her... Especially about why we broke up... And they're all probably true.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: But that doesn't change the fact that she and I had a real connection, at least for a while. I don't want you to think otherwise. That wouldn't be honest.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I think I understand. You two... You had a lot of fun.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yeah... I... I suppose we did.
Emily stares out the window, watching the beach fly by... And then an idea pops into her head!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Kimi said I should try something spontaneous... This is my chance!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Hey! I have a great idea! Let's go for a swim!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What? Here? Now?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Why not? Let's do something fun and crazy!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uh... Sure... Okay...
Ben pulls over on the side of the road...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I'm not sure I can park here...

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Come on, it'll only be a few minutes! It'll be fine!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yeah... You're probably right...
Emily and Ben hop out and rush off across the beach...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Bet you can't beat me to the water!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Oh, it's on!
The two rush up to the water and dive in! They swim through the crashing waves...

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Keep up, slow-poke!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: No fair! You're, like, a world-class swimmer!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Aw, should I slow down?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Actually, you probably shouldn't... Because `I'm` a world-class splasher!
nodes.text_bbcode: Actually, you probably shouldn't... Because [color=#e23b3b][i]I'm[/i][/color] a world-class splasher!

nodes.text: Ben squeezes his hands together, shooting a perfect spout of water right at Emily!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Ah!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: We call that the Kale Cannon! I perfected it when I was 7!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Well, I'm impressed...
Emily swims over to Ben, and the two embrace in the water...

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: This is fun, right? We're having fun?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Of course we are! Why wouldn't we be? I always have fun with you!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I know but... Isn't this crazy and spontaneous?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uh... Sure...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Emily, is there something you want to talk about?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: No... Of course not...

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Uh... Splash attack!
Emily splashes Ben! He laughs and dodges it... And then freezes!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Oh no! My car!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: What about it?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: `It's getting towed!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]It's getting towed![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Emily spins around to see that back on the shore, Ben's car has been rigged to the back of a tow truck!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Oh no!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Hurry!
Emily and Ben swim as fast as they can...
But it's too late. They get back to the road just in time to see the tow truck drive away.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You have `got` to be kidding me!
nodes.text_bbcode: You have [color=#e23b3b][i]got[/i][/color] to be kidding me!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Oh, Ben... I'm so sorry... What do we do now?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What `can` we do? All I've got is 25 bucks... That's not enough to get my car out of the impound!
nodes.text_bbcode: What [color=#e23b3b][i]can[/i][/color] we do? All I've got is 25 bucks... That's not enough to get my car out of the impound!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: We're going to have to walk to the train station, and take one down to Twin Branches... My dad'll just have to come back for the car later...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: He's going to kill me... If your dad doesn't kill me first. I mean, if we have to take the train, there's no way we'll be back by 7!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Oh no...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I'm sorry, Emily.
A little while later, Ben and Emily walk through Chinatown on the way to the train station.
Ben consults a train schedule...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Well... It looks like we'll be back in town by 9:30... That's not `that` bad...
nodes.text_bbcode: Well... It looks like we'll be back in town by 9:30... That's not [color=#e23b3b][i]that[/i][/color] bad...

nodes.text: Emily tries to say something, then bursts into tears!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Hey... `Hey.` It's okay. It's not that bad.
nodes.text_bbcode: Hey... [color=#e23b3b][i]Hey.[/i][/color] It's okay. It's not that bad.

nodes.text: Ben puts his arm around Emily.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I'm sure your dad'll get over it...

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: It's not that, Ben! It's... It's...

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: This is `all` my fault!
nodes.text_bbcode: This is [color=#3b78e2][i]all[/i][/color] my fault!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: No... It could've happened to anyone...

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: No, Ben, it couldn't! It wouldn't have happened to Jessica!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Huh? What does Jessica have to do with this!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: She has `everything` to do with it, Ben!
nodes.text_bbcode: She has [color=#3b78e2][i]everything[/i][/color] to do with it, Ben!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: If you'd been with her, the two of you would've had a crazy adventure swimming together, and then you would've run into some kind of a party boat, and they would've taken you on board, and you would've had the best time!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: But I try to do `one` fun thing, one crazy thing, and it turns into a total disaster!
nodes.text_bbcode: But I try to do [color=#3b78e2][i]one[/i][/color] fun thing, one crazy thing, and it turns into a total disaster!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I'm the worst, Ben! I suck! I'm no fun at all!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Is... Is `that` what all this is about? You're anxious because you heard about Jessica?
nodes.text_bbcode: Is... Is [color=#e23b3b][i]that[/i][/color] what all this is about? You're anxious because you heard about Jessica?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Well... Yeah!
Ben pulls Emily close and starts laughing.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: What? Why are you laughing? What's funny?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: It's just... Out of everything you could be insecure about... That is the absolute silliest possible thing.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Emily, I swear to you... You are a thousand, million, `billion` times better girlfriend than Jessica `ever` was!
nodes.text_bbcode: Emily, I swear to you... You are a thousand, million, [color=#e23b3b][i]billion[/i][/color] times better girlfriend than Jessica [color=#e23b3b][i]ever[/i][/color] was!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: But... You guys all had these fun adventures... She was so crazy and wild...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uh, yeah, exactly. She was `crazy` and `wild.` Those are nice words for `unstable.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Uh, yeah, exactly. She was [color=#e23b3b][i]crazy[/i][/color] and [color=#e23b3b][i]wild.[/i][/color] Those are nice words for [color=#e23b3b][i]unstable.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Honestly, Em, she was `exhausting.` All day, every day, it was just this whirlwind. It was like dating a tornado. Also, possibly a sociopath.
nodes.text_bbcode: Honestly, Em, she was [color=#e23b3b][i]exhausting.[/i][/color] All day, every day, it was just this whirlwind. It was like dating a tornado. Also, possibly a sociopath.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: With you, I'm relaxed. I'm happy. I'm myself.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: And before you ask... I have more fun with you in one week than I did in my entire relationship with Jessica.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Really?
Ben kisses Emily.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Really.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Oh, Ben, I...

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Your car!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Huh?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: There! Look! Your car!
Emily points down the street! There, driving down a parallel street, is the tow truck!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You're right! But... What do we do?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: ...Something spontaneous.
Emily grins and takes off running!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: `Emily!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Emily![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Using the incredible athleticism she's honed as a swimmer, she races down the crowded Chinatown streets, weaving around food stands, statues, and pedestrians...
And comes out right in front of the tow truck! It screeches to a halt!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: `Gotcha!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Gotcha![/i][/color]

nodes.text: She runs around the side and bangs on the driver's door. It swings open...

nodes.speaker: Driver
nodes.text: Hey, lady, what's the big idea?!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Sorry to bother you, sir, but that red sedan happens to be my boyfriend's car... And we'd like it back!

nodes.speaker: Driver
nodes.text: Uh, no-can-do, lady. I can't just go around giving people back their cars! I gotta take 'em to the impound!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I'll pay you twenty bucks.

nodes.speaker: Driver
nodes.text: Deal!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Yes!
And so, a few minutes later, Emily and Ben drive through San Francisco...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: That was `amazing!` I can't believe you chased down a tow truck!
nodes.text_bbcode: That was [color=#e23b3b][i]amazing![/i][/color] I can't believe you chased down a tow truck!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Oh, it was nothing...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Nothing? Are you kidding me? You hopped over a sizzling noodle stand!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Okay, that `was` kind of cool, I'll admit...
nodes.text_bbcode: Okay, that [color=#3b78e2][i]was[/i][/color] kind of cool, I'll admit...

nodes.text: Ben leans over and squeezes Emily's hand.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I meant what I said earlier, you know.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Emily Kessler, you're the best girlfriend I could ever want.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: And you're the very best boyfriend in the world.
Emily and Ben kiss.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Do you still want to go the Science Museum?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uh, yeah, are you kidding? The Science Museum is great!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: They've got this one exhibit where you fill balloons with hydrogen and then blow them up...
It looks like Ben and Emily are on their way to having a great date!
